about: The current El Niño outlook, shared by the El Niño watch on /signals/, the explainer at /el-nino/ and the guide at /el-nino-and-cities/ (read through tools/enso-outlook.js). Each entry keeps the issuer's own issue date, forecast period, geography and index; entries with different indices or baselines are never combined. Every entry names the claims it rests on in research/2026-11/enso-asia/claims.json; the build stops if one has not passed the source check. To update: stage the new bulletin in that batch, run verify-sources.yml (month 2026-11-enso-asia) and gate.js, then edit this file. 'checked' is the editorial check date: it appears in source details and metadata only, never as a date the content was added.

status.label: El Niño Advisory
status.means: NOAA's alert status when El Niño conditions are observed and expected to continue.
status.observed: El Niño strengthened compared with the previous month: sea surface temperature anomalies exceeded 4.0 °C and extended farther west across the eastern equatorial Pacific. The weekly Niño-3.4 index reached +2.5 °C, and rainfall stayed suppressed over Indonesia.
status.forecast: A strong-to-very strong El Niño is likely through January to March 2027 (a greater than 79% chance), before it begins to weaken in early 2027.

phase.title: Official ENSO probabilities
phase.index: Relative Oceanic Niño Index (RONI), Niño-3.4 region, 1991–2020 base, ±0.5 °C thresholds

others.title: Global Seasonal Climate Update for November 2026 to January 2027
others.geography: Niño 3.4 region and the Indian Ocean
others.index: Niño 3.4 sea surface temperature anomaly, multi-model ensemble mean (not RONI)
others.says: The seasonal average anomaly is forecast at about +3.8 °C, peaking around December 2026; a positive Indian Ocean Dipole is forecast to decline to +0.3 °C.

others.title: El Niño/La Niña Update
others.index: Consensus of WMO Global Producing Centres
others.says: An exceptionally high likelihood, nearly 100%, that El Niño persists through February 2027.

others.title: Seasonal forecast for November 2026 to January 2027
others.says: Below-normal rainfall over parts of the southeastern and northeastern Maritime Continent and southeastern mainland Southeast Asia, and above-normal temperature over the ASEAN region. National services hold the national-scale outlook.

others.title: El Niño/La Niña status
others.says: The relative Niño3.4 index was 2.1 °C for September and 1.7 °C for July to September, and was predicted to peak during October to December 2026.
